subject: Kickoff: FLOAT part-level scene parsing
body:
Team — kicking off the FLOAT scene-parsing track.

FLOAT factorizes object attributes for multi-object multi-part parsing — the CVPR 2022 work — and part-level segmentation is what the imagery-understanding roadmap needs next: object masks alone don't cut it for the editing features downstream teams are asking about.

Plan for the window: (1) environment and repro by Apr 10 — the release ships training and inference notebooks with preset settings, and datasets come from the Zenodo archive, so this should be mechanical; (2) convert the notebooks into a proper training pipeline by mid-May (notebooks don't survive contact with our cluster scheduler); (3) evaluate on our internal part-annotated set through May; (4) integration recommendation by Jun 12.

Csilla owns modeling, Gustavo training infra, Tereza evals, Wei analysis, Katya the internal-dataset work. Deshawn follows up on resourcing.

Lucia
